messages:
Talia (Design): Uploaded new Trace UI comps — main asks: make corr-id copy frictionless, clarify export consent modal (data & cost hints), and improve keyboard discoverability. Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/trace-consent-v1 :eyes:
Ravi (Eng): Quick read: inline copy with toast + sr-only success text is fine. For large copies we should stream to avoid blocking the UI. Also backend must surface per-org export policy flag.
Jared - PM: Product wants an explicit consent step when a user requests a full trace export: show estimated size, org policy (redacted/disabled), and an opt-in checkbox that logs consent. Quick summary export remains one-click.
Maya (A11y): Accessibility notes: consent modal must be role=dialog, trap focus, and include clear aria-describedby explaining what data is included. Announce export start in a polite live region; avoid spamming updates.
Talia (Design): Microcopy for consent: header: "Export full trace"; body: "This export may contain sensitive data. Estimated size: ~{size}. By continuing you acknowledge that this data will be downloaded to your device." Checkbox label: "I understand and want to download this trace". Thoughts?
Ravi (Eng): Sounds good. Implementation: require server-side log entry for consent (user id, trace id, timestamp). For Private orgs full export button should be hidden and replaced with "Request export" that opens an approval flow.
Jared - PM: For compliance, add a small link in the modal: "How exports are handled in Dedicated & Private" that links to our policy doc. Also show a tiny cost hint: "May incur egress charges" under the size estimate.
Maya (A11y): For the checkbox ensure accessible name includes the export format e.g., "I understand and want to download this trace (NDJSON)". If the export is redacted show explanatory text: "Sensitive fields have been redacted per org policy."
Talia (Design): For keyboard discoverability: add a small `?` help overlay listing scoped shortcuts when trace list is focused (C = copy corr-id, S = download summary, F = request full export). Single-letter keys only active when focused.
Ravi (Eng): We'll scope via JS and show the focus hint. Also adding server header X-Estimated-Bytes for size estimate and SSE events for progress. Cancel should call an abort endpoint and emit a final event.
Jared - PM: Acceptance criteria: 1) inline corr-id copy + toast + sr-only text 2) consent modal for full exports with checkbox + log event + policy link + cost hint 3) quick summary one-click export 4) Private/Dedicated request flow instead of direct export 5) a11y checklist in PR (dialog roles, live region, checkbox naming) 6) keyboard help overlay + conflict matrix.
Talia (Design): I'll update Figma with the consent modal, keyboard-help overlay, and high-contrast copy chip. Pushing assets by EOD.
deploy-bot: Design snapshot uploaded: https://s3.company/internal/trace-export-consent-v1.png
Ravi (Eng): Scheduling 25m handoff Fri 11am. I'll add backend tickets: consent audit log, X-Estimated-Bytes header, SSE progress, abort endpoint, feature-flag per org.
Maya (A11y): I'll author the a11y checklist and run quick keyboard/voiceover pass during handoff.
Jared - PM: Thanks team — please link the updated mocks in the ticket and include the accessibility checklist before merging."
